facts: HABS SC-319 pages 14–15. Original masonry, nineteen bays on long faces and five bay ends, two projecting ten-column granite Corinthian porticoes, hipped roof, balustrade and dentiled cornice, simple upper openings and decorated middle windows.
South Carolina General Assembly exterior notes identify granite construction, copper outer dome and approximate 180-foot total height.
Current landmark appearance incorporates the 1995–98 restoration, which retained the copper outer dome.
